basic_details.short_information: CPCL Executive Recruitment 2026: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited (CPCL), a Navratna Central Public Sector Enterprise and group company of Indian Oil Corporation Limited, has released for 41 Executive vacancies. The recruitment includes Engineer, Officer, Junior Officer, Manager and Senior Manager positions across engineering, information systems, official language and company secretarial disciplines. Candidates with the prescribed educational qualifications and relevant post-qualification experience can apply. The upper age limit is 28 years for Post Codes CPCL01 to CPCL07, and 42 or 45

content_sections.text: CPCL has released the detailed for recruitment of 41 Executives in engineering, information systems, official language and secretarial disciplines. Official Notification PDF: Download CPCL Executive Recruitment 2026 Detailed Notification

content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive Vacancy 2026 - 41 Posts
content_sections.text: CPCL has advertised 41 vacancies across eight position codes . Chemical Engineering has the highest number of posts with 22 vacancies. The advertised total includes two backlog vacancies. *Reservation Note: ST and OBC totals for Engineer (Chemical) include one backlog vacancy each. PwBD reservation is horizontal and included within the advertised vacancies. The notification specifies certain carried-forward PwBD reservations for Chemical, Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, while one Information Systems Officer position is earmarked for hearing disability.

content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess the prescribed educational qualification and relevant post-qualification work experience as on 1 October 2026. The exact degree, minimum marks and experience requirements depend on the selected position. Important: The Manager and Senior Manager designations share one vacancy under CPCL08. The grade of appointment will be decided by CPCL based on the applicant's eligibility, experience, suitability and selection performance. The relaxed marks requirement is not available indiscriminately for every discipline. For example, the Civil Engineer vacancy permits 55% for eligible SC candidates against reserved positions, while the sole Instrumentation Engineer post has a 60% requirement without a separately notified reserved-category marks concession. Marks Calculation: CPCL calculates aggregate percentage using marks obtained in all subjects across all semesters or years. Fractions are ignored; 59.99% does not meet a 60% requirement. Candidates need a first-class Engineering or Technology degree in Chemical, Petroleum or Petrochemicals with at least 60% aggregate marks, subject to the notified concession for eligible reserved candidates. At least two years of post-qualification experience in relevant process units is mandatory, preferably in refining, chemical, petrochemical, fertilizer or hydrocarbon-processing industries. Exposure to commissioning, start-up, shutdown, troubleshooting, DCS, P&IDs, HAZOP and safety practices is advantageous. A first-class Mechanical Engineering/Technology degree and at least two years of post-qualification experience in a process industry are required. Experience with static and rotary mechanical equipment such as pumps, compressors, heaters, columns and exchangers is relevant. Maintenance planning, inspection and condition-monitoring knowledge are advantageous. Candidates need an Electrical or Electrical and Electronics Engineering/Technology degree with the prescribed minimum marks and two years of relevant post-qualification experience. Experience involving LT/HT motors, transformers, breakers, electrical control panels, switchgear and maintenance systems is relevant to the post. Applicants must possess a first-class Civil Engineering/Technology degree and at least two years of relevant post-qualification experience in process units, preferably in refining, petrochemicals, chemicals, fertilizers or hydrocarbon processing. Structural design, civil erection, project monitoring, rate analysis, tendering and contract management experience are advantageous. Candidates need an Engineering/Technology degree in Instrumentation, including Electronics and Instrumentation, with at least 60% aggregate marks. Two years of post-qualification experience in a relevant process industry, particularly maintenance of instrumentation, analysers and DCS/PLC control systems, is mandatory. content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Age will be calculated as on 1 October 2026 . The maximum age for Post Codes CPCL01 to CPCL07 is 28 years, while the Secretarial position has higher grade-specific limits. Important: Cumulative age relaxation is not permitted. SC/ST/OBC relaxation is subject to the vacancy reservation conditions specified in the notification.

rows.upper_age_relaxation: 5 Years Under the Notified Service Conditions

content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive Salary 2026
content_sections.text: CPCL offers IDA pay scales with initial basic pay ranging from Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 90,000 per month , according to the selected position and grade. In addition to basic pay, eligible employees receive Industrial Dearness Allowance, HRA, cafeteria allowance, conveyance maintenance, performance-related pay, provident fund, gratuity, medical benefits, leave travel benefits and other applicable allowances under CPCL rules. Salary Clarification: CTC includes various employer benefits and performance-related components. It should not be treated as take-home salary. No pay protection is admissible under the notified conditions.

content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee is Rs. 500 for General, EWS and OBC-NCL candidates . SC, ST, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen and women candidates are exempt from payment. Payment Mode: SBI e-pay using Debit Card, Credit Card, UPI or Net Banking, as available through the application facility. Payment Deadline: 3 December 2026. The fee is non-refundable, except for applicable reversal of duplicate deductions caused by technical issues as described in the portal instructions. Additional bank charges, if any, must be borne by the candidate.

content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process differs between Post Codes CPCL01 to CPCL07 and CPCL08. Applicants should prepare according to the assessment pattern applicable to their chosen position. Computer Based Test (CBT). Shortlisting based on CBT performance. Group Discussion / Group Task. Personal Interview. Document Verification. Pre-Employment Medical Examination. Computer Based Test (CBT). Skill Test. Personal Interview. Document Verification. Medical Examination. Manager/Senior Manager (Secretarial) candidates will be shortlisted based on qualification, experience and overall suitability, followed by Group Discussion/Group Task and Personal Interview. The official notification does not prescribe a CBT for CPCL08.

content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive CBT Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The CBT for Post Codes CPCL01 to CPCL07 consists of 120 objective questions carrying 120 marks , with a duration of two hours. The General Aptitude section covers: Verbal Ability General Knowledge Reasoning and Logical Deduction Numerical Ability

content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive Final Selection Weightage 2026
content_sections.text: Qualifying marks must be secured separately in the applicable CBT and Personal Interview stages. Merely obtaining the qualifying marks does not guarantee selection, because final merit depends on the prescribed weighted assessment.

content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive Service Bond 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates appointed under Post Codes CPCL01 to CPCL07 must execute a service bond to serve CPCL for a minimum period of three years from the date of joining.

content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply online for the 41 Executive vacancies from 4 November to 3 December 2026 . Official Website: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited Detailed Notification: Application Last Date: 3 December 2026. Candidates must apply for only one post using their active personal email address and mobile number.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for CPCL Executive Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official CPCL website at www.cpcl.co.in . Open the Careers or Recruitment section. Find . Open the official Executive Recruitment application link. Read the instructions and accept the declaration checkbox. Click Continue . Select the eligible position from the Post Applying for dropdown. Enter the required basic personal information. Verify the email address and mobile number using OTP. Submit the new user registration form. Save the generated User ID and Password. Log in using the registration credentials. Complete Personal Details, including parents' names, marital status, identity proof and address information. Click Save and Continue. Enter Academic Details and the relevant qualification information. Enter mandatory post-qualification Work Experience details. Upload the scanned passport-size photograph. Upload the scanned signature. Upload the required documents and certificates in PDF format. Open the Preview section and verify all entered information. Use the Edit option to correct mistakes before final submission. Click Proceed to Payment and accept the required declaration. Submit the application. Details cannot be changed after final submission. Pay the applicable registration fee through the payment gateway, if required. Download the submitted application form and payment receipt from the candidate dashboard. Complete all required steps by 3 December 2026 . Important: Do not submit applications for multiple posts. CPCL permits only one post per candidate and does not refund registration fees paid for multiple applications.

content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive Recruitment 2026 Documents Required
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload the documents requested by the application portal and produce original supporting certificates during document verification. Educational degree certificates and all relevant marksheets. Class 10 or Higher Secondary certificate for age verification. Relevant post-qualification work experience certificates. Valid photo identity proof. Recent passport-size photograph. Scanned signature. SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS certificate, where applicable. PwBD disability certificate, where applicable. Ex-Servicemen certificate, where applicable. ICSI Associate Membership and examination records for CPCL08. Relevant degree specialization evidence, where required. Official CGPA-to-percentage conversion proof, where applicable. No Objection Certificate for eligible Government/PSU employees. Additional documents requested by CPCL for verification. The final upload requirements should be checked against the Executive Recruitment application instructions and the applicable fields before submission.

content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive Reservation and Certificate Requirements
content_sections.text: Reservation is available according to Government of India rules and the post-wise allocation in the notification. Candidates claiming OBC Non-Creamy Layer reservation must possess a valid Central Government format certificate issued by the competent authority on or after 1 April 2026 . OBC candidates belonging to the creamy layer are not eligible for OBC-NCL reservation benefits. Applicants claiming EWS reservation must provide the prescribed Income and Asset Certificate issued by the competent authority on or after 1 April 2026 . PwBD reservation applies only to identified functional disability categories suitable for each post. Eligible candidates must possess the prescribed disability certificate. As CPCL operates hazardous industrial facilities, the notification specifies post-wise functional requirements and identified disability categories. Applicants must check the relevant table on pages 3 and 4 before claiming suitability or reservation.

content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive Admit Card and CBT Examination 2026
content_sections.text: CPCL will make CBT admit cards available through its recruitment website. The tentative release period is approximately 10 days before the examination . Candidates will be required to download the call letter using the prescribed login credentials and follow the instructions regarding photograph, original photo ID and other documents. Admit cards will not be sent by post. The CBT is tentatively scheduled for December 2026 or January 2027, with Chennai as the proposed examination location.
